text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Prime Minister Abdellatif Filali reiterates Morocco's commitment on the side of Lebanon for peace in the region.
- Justice Minister Abderrahman Amalu underlines Morocco's efforts to eradicate drugs.
- Lebanese Prime Minister Rafik al-Hariri starts three-day visit to Morocco, heading an important delegation.
- Health workers on two-day strike after last week's stoppage failed.
- European Investment Bank grants Morocco a $151 million loan for railway and water projects.
- Morocco and Arab United Emirates agree on the principle of setting up a free trade zone.
- Prime minister says the state will keep control of telecommunications sector even after its privatisation.
